changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: a base-width band on the analog filter, all analog.
TYP turns past PK to BW: FRQ sets the band's low edge, RES's knob reads WID and sets how far above it the top edge sits, shown in hertz.
FRQ, its locks and an LFO on it move the whole band; an LFO or lock on WID changes the width; the filter envelope sweeps the band.
The FILTER graph draws the band as the filter plays it. Wider bands are quieter: set VOL by ear.
